name: Portland Stage Summer Theater Camps
description_short: Week-long theater day camps (9 am–3 pm) for rising K–12th graders at Portland Stage, each themed around a book, play or style such as improv or Shakespeare. Professional actors, directors and artisans teach the camps, and each week ends with an open studio performance for families.
refund_policy_summary: You get a full refund if you cancel more than two months before the first day, a 50% refund between two months and one month before, and no refund less than one month before. If Portland Stage cancels a program for low enrollment, it tells families two weeks ahead and gives a full refund. Signing up for more than one week gets a 10% discount.
